title: Cannot find Module
body:
Hi,

Ive set this up with the following config:
    "windows-cli": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@simonb97/server-win-cli"]
    },

I get the following error

node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:275
    throw new ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND(
          ^

Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find module 'C:\Users\JohnGray\AppData\Local\npm-cache\_npx\b7043670c3149184\node_modules\@modelcontextprotocol\sdk\server\index.js' imported from C:\Users\JohnGray\AppData\Local\npm-cache\_npx\b7043670c3149184\node_modules\@simonb97\server-win-cli\dist\index.js
    at finalizeResolution (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:275:11)
    at moduleResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:860:10)
    at defaultResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:984:11)
    at ModuleLoader.defaultResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/loader:685:12)
    at #cachedDefaultResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/loader:634:25)
    at ModuleLoader.resolve (node:internal/modules/esm/loader:617:38)
    at ModuleLoader.getModuleJobForImport (node:internal/modules/esm/loader:273:38)
    at ModuleJob._link (node:internal/modules/esm/module_job:135:49) {
  code: 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND',
  url: 'file:///C:/Users/JohnGray/AppData/Local/npm-cache/_npx/b7043670c3149184/node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/index.js'
}

Would you be able to advise how i fix this?
author: johngraymcs

comments.body: Hi, your server setup looks good. Have you been able to use a different Node-based MCP-server without errors?

You might also try clearing your npm cache:
`npm cache clean --force`

title: Installation fails
body:
Following your directions exactly, the basic installation fails to connect to the server.

    "windows-cli": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@simonb97/server-win-cli"]
    }

In the log for mcp-server-windows-cli.log, there's a bunch of error messages around npm cleanup and cannot find file in the npm-cache\_npx directory.  This just doesn't work and I don't understand why I'm having these problems.  I just installed another mcp server with npx and args very similar and it worked fine.  

Can you offer any help?
author: unoriginalscreenname

comments.body: Hi, since the logs indicate some cache-related issues, have you tried clearing the npm cache with `npm cache clean --force`?
Closing because stalled. Please feel free to re-open if the issue persists!

title: I need to add "CHCP 65001" to this configuration now. How do I add it?
body:
In win-cli-mcp-server, there is a cmd configuration:
```
"cmd": {
"enabled": true,
"command": "cmd.exe",
"args": ["/c"],
"blockedOperators": [ "|", ";", ""]
},
```
I tried 
```
"cmd": {
  "enabled": true,
  "command": "cmd.exe",
  "args": ["/c", "chcp", "65001", "&"],
  "blockedOperators": ["|", ";", "`"]
}
```
but failed.

I need to add "CHCP 65001" to this configuration now. How do I add it?
author: trunks023

comments.body:
Hello and thank you for the issue, tho I'm not sure if I get your problem correctly. 

I *think* you are trying to specify some arguments that should be blocked for cmd.exe, but the server is not actually blocking after setting them in the configuration file.

Could you please elaborate and provide your config + the server launch command?
Closing as this seems solved/inactive. Feel free to re-open if still relevant.

title: Command chaining operators are not allowed (;, &, |, `)
body:
Hi, came across this issue:

{
  `shell`: `powershell`,
  `command`: `[some powershell with a query paramater]' 'AzureDiagnostics | take 2'`
}

So when passing parameters like a kudo query in this case should allow the pipe character

I know i can disable that check globally, but that's risky.
author: BartNetJS

comments.body: Hi @SimonB97, thanks for the quick fix
